LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.0.label: First Flame
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Flame evolution. Refinement: spreading burn damage or the extra detonation bonus. Consumed burn damage is returned in full. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.1.label: Firebrand
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.1.description: Three ordinary hits within 6 seconds brand the last victim for 6 seconds, keeping at most two brands. Your next ordinary hit on that victim spends the brand for 50 extra damage. Brand generation has a 3-second cooldown; bonus damage cannot brand again. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.2.label: Furnace Heart
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.2.description: Every two ordinary hits store one heat, at most once per 0.5 seconds. Store up to three; heat expires after 10 seconds without renewal. At full heat, the next ordinary hit spends three for 75 extra damage. Venting starts a 3-second cooldown that pauses heat generation. Bonus damage never generates heat. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.3.label: Chasing Flame
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.3.description: A real Firebrand bonus hit leaves a 6-second tinder mark on its victim. Your Flame ability hit spends it for 75 extra damage. Keep up to two tinder marks; one-second cooldown per victim. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.4.label: Flying Cinders
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.4.description: A real Firebrand bonus hit splashes 50 damage to another enemy within 3 cells of its victim, with a 2-second cooldown. No available secondary target means no splash cooldown is spent. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.5.label: Furnace Vent
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.5.description: A real Furnace Heart vent splashes 50 damage each to up to two other enemies within 3 cells, with a 3-second cooldown. Splash damage generates no heat. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.6.label: Bank the Fire
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.6.description: A real Furnace Heart vent grants you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, with a 3-second cooldown. This layer refreshes to its budget rather than adding to its remainder, and cannot generate heat. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.7.label: Falling Embers
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.7.description: A real Chasing Flame bonus plants a cinder at the impact cell. After 1.5 seconds it deals 50 damage each to at most two enemies within 2 cells, with a 3-second cooldown. The cinder stays on the ground. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.8.label: Passing Fire
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.8.description: Victims actually hit by Flying Cinders carry embers for 4 seconds. Your ordinary hit spends an ember for 50 extra damage. Remember up to two victims, with a one-second cooldown per victim. Embers cannot create Firebrand or Flying Cinders. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.9.label: Cinder Bed
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.9.description: When one Furnace Vent damages two distinct secondary victims, leave a 3-second cinder bed at the original primary target cell. Your ordinary hit on an enemy within 2 cells spends it for 75 extra damage, once per bed. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.10.label: Returning Heat
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.10.description: When Bank the Fire actually absorbs hostile damage, remember the attacker for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on it returns up to 50 damage, never more than that hit’s actual absorption, and spends the record. Only the latest absorption is remembered. Other shields do not fuel this effect. Refinement: counter-damage cap. Actual absorption is not multiplied. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.11.label: Draw to the Fire
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.11.description: Before Falling Embers erupts, move from within 3 cells of its cinder to outside that radius. Your next ordinary hit detonates the same cinder early, retaining its area, targets and single payout. Refinement: early detonation damage. Natural detonation is unchanged, and no new cinder is created. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.12.label: Kindle Again
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.12.description: When Falling Embers damages an enemy, remember it for 3 seconds, keeping at most two victims. A later Flame ability hit on it spends the record for a 50-damage burst within 1.5 cells at its current position, hitting at most two enemies. This makes no new cinder. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.13.label: Converging Flames
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.13.description: Spend Passing Fire embers on two different enemies within 3 seconds to hold Converging Flames for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit spends it for 75 extra damage on its victim. Another pair of target switches is needed to prepare it again. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.14.label: Borrowed Flame
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.14.description: A real Passing Fire bonus heals up to 40 non-permanent injury on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells, with a 4-second cooldown. No injured recipient means no cooldown is spent. Healing creates no embers. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 40. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.15.label: Sealed Furnace
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.15.description: While a cinder bed exists, the vent cooldown still blocks venting but no longer pauses heat generation. Switch targets to rebuild at least one heat and extend that bed by 2 seconds once. Spending the extended bed uses one extra heat to add 25 base damage, refined independently of the bed itself. Without enough heat, only the bed damage is paid. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.16.label: Walk the Coals
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.16.description: After spending a cinder bed, remember your position for 3 seconds. Walk at least 3 cells away from that position and hit a different enemy to grant 2-point, 3-second shields to up to two allied colonists within 2 cells of the old bed. One payout, consumed even if no ally remains nearby; allies need no interaction. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.17.label: Stoke the Pressure
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.17.description: After Returning Heat deals bonus damage, remember that enemy for 3 seconds. Another ordinary hit spends the record to delay its current ordinary weapon warmup by 0.5 seconds. Only a recognized weapon warmup is affected; airborne projectiles and special boss timers are unchanged. Without an eligible warmup, retain the record until expiry. Only the latest enemy is remembered. Repeated node trials increase the delay from 0.5 seconds toward 0.595 seconds with diminishing returns, rounded to the nearest game tick. The three-second mark window and one-use rule remain unchanged. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.18.label: Shared Warmth
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Flame.nodes.18.description: After Returning Heat deals bonus damage, grant half of its actual damage as a shield, up to 2 points for 3 seconds, to the nearest other colonist within 4 cells. Repeated grants refresh this layer rather than adding to its remainder. No ally means no shield. This shield cannot trigger Returning Heat. Refinement: shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
